svg.title: The AI-strategy pipeline — v2, 2026-09-19
svg.desc: Capture, derive, author, gate, promote, execute, observe. The strategist authors two different products — a data-only ruleset table that the engine VM runs with no AI in the loop, and coded Rust members that occupy their own slots. Both pass the same gate: the real engine replaying the real capture, with exit 3 and no override. Strategy identities and research verdicts are deliberately absent from this sheet; it is tracked in git and they are not.
svg.text: The AI-strategy pipeline

text.tspan: capture → derive → author → gate → promote → execute → observe
· v2.1, 2026-09-19 (E7 review) · the 2026-09-05 sheet is kept unmodified at
What changed since v1: the strategist no longer authors only ruleset tables.
Four coded Rust members were authored, gated and put into paper in eleven days, and both model-sidecar lanes closed. Which members, and which lanes, is not on this sheet.

svg.text: live in paper
gated / refused
operator-gated
AI plane
A
CAPTURE
engine, Rust, continuous, no AI anywhere in the loop
One run directory per boot, restarted on a UTC-day gate so each day is one gap-free run. Every normalized record is appended to PMLR before
it is pushed to the ring — a tick the ring drops must still reach the replay log. §6.5 makes capture the product: a capture-open failure is a fatal boot error.
<venue>-ticks
kind 0 · 64 B
<venue>-signals
kind 1
engine-fills
kind 2
engine-orders
kind 3 · the attribution log
ai-cmds
kind 4 · every accepted frame
<venue>-events
kind 5
<venue>-opt-summary
kind 6
<venue>-depth
kind 7 · 192 B

instrument-manifest.tsv is rewritten every boot and every offline consumer joins through it by DESCRIPTOR string — option and PM-daily ordinals reshuffle per boot by design, so a bare SymbolId is meaningless across runs. Skipping this once produced a phantom $248.8M per-symbol bound.
B
DERIVE AND FETCH
worker, Python, offline, globally serialized — never the hot path
candles.db — the research data plane
SQLite WAL, written by MODULES on launchd cadence, never by a verb.
candles · candle_conflicts · funding · iv_digest · depth_digest · refdata
PK (venue, descriptor, tf, open_ts) — never a bare SymbolId.
Fetch one base per horizon and derive the rest: 1m / 1h / 1d fetched;
5m / 15m / 4h derived exactly. A closed bar is immutable — a
disagreeing re-fetch is a logged conflict, not an overwrite.
PMLR read back by mmap
claude_worker/pmlr.py maps the capture read-only and casts over it.
This is the same tape the gate will replay, so what the strategist
measures and what the backtest scores cannot diverge.
features/<run>/*.json and market-map.json are files, never a socket.
Map refresh is ADDITIVE ONLY — a moved name is a reported conflict.
keyless public REST, budgeted
RestBudget 60 req / venue / hour, pooled per HOST.
PM Gamma · OKX candles · Deribit chart · HL candleSnapshot.
No LLM call happens anywhere in stage B. --news is mechanical:
it pulls and dedupes; the session is the triage brain.
Every launchd script pgreps for a running worker first — one
sequence namespace, one writer, always.
C
AUTHOR
the strategist reads FILES only, never a socket — and now writes two different kinds of thing

This is the change that v1 did not show. A ruleset is data the engine interprets; a member is Rust that ships in the binary. They have different authors, different review, different blast radius — and the same gate.
PRODUCT 1 · the ruleset table — data, not code
≤ 256 rows × 128 B in a fixed grammar. Nothing the strategist writes
ever executes as code; it produces data a hand-written validator either
admits or rejects.
17 features mid · bid · ask | roll_mean · roll_ema · roll_min · roll_max ·
roll_std | apr24 · apr72 · clock_to_funding | mark_px · mark_iv |
depth_imb · depth_spread_bps · depth_notional | clock_utc_sod
4 combines diff · diff_bps · ratio · (lhs_only inferred for a ref-less row)
Identity is the SHA-256 of the file bytes. Only the first 16 of those bytes
— hash128 — ever travel on the wire. Lands in slot 5.
PRODUCT 2 · a coded member — Rust, its own slot
A new crate in crates/, wired into the strategy set's slot and bit tables,
with a docs/migration.md entry. Four were authored this way in eleven days.
What each one trades is not on this sheet. What matters to the pipeline is
that a coded member cannot be expressed in the ruleset grammar at all, ships
inside the binary, and therefore carries a far larger blast radius than a
table — which is why each needed an explicit operator ruling on top of the gate.
Each displaced a predecessor rather than taking a free slot. The wire slot
numbers never moved, so the whole attribution history stays readable straight
through the change of tenant.
D
GATE
the REAL engine VM replays the REAL capture · exit 3 is final — no override flag exists anywhere in the tree

The harness conforms to the worker, never the reverse. backtest.py and cli.py have gone byte-untouched across five sessions, and the subprocess contract is frozen: schema-1 JSON on stdout only, human summary to stderr.
the same code that trades
k-way merge to a total order (ts_ns, venue byte,
record idx) · VIRT_T0 rebase · runs never interleave
the REAL VmStrategy via receive_table_v2 and a
synthesized Commit — no second interpreter exists
the SAME ingress_ai::validate_ruleset — no second
parser can drift from the first
the fill law is deliberately pessimistic
strict-cross maker, zero RNG: a resting BID at P fills
only when ask < P — through, never a touch
fill px is always P · displayed size is a SHARED
FIFO budget · latency Δ per venue, 100–600 ms
doctrine: the backtest may under-promise; it must
never over-promise
five hard gates, in code
OOS > 0
≥ 50 trades and ≥ 2 trading days
drawdown ≤ $200
bounds ≤ $100 / $250 / $1000 per order / symbol / table
report hash must equal the recomputed file hash,
or the report is untrusted and the run exits 2
THE GATE BINDING SITE — where refusal becomes mechanical rather than cultural

claude-worker stage-ruleset recomputes sha256 over the artifact, and refuses to send unless the worker's own backtest report matches THAT hash, is schema-1, and carries gates.all_passed. A report written on FAIL still exists — it is the evidence, not the permission.

The intent lane has no equivalent. An OrderIntent frame passes wire shape, a 15-second staleness check and the regime gate, and nothing statistical: that asymmetry is deliberate, and it is why the intent lane is paper-only and the table lane is the one that carries research.
E
PROMOTE
82-byte HMAC'd frame over a Unix socket · validated a SECOND time by the same validator, on the engine side
install
artifact lands at AI_RULESET_DIR/<hash128>.json
stage
kind 7 · engine resolves the file, runs the 11-rule validator,
ferries the table by value
commit
kind 8 · valid only if the staged hash matches · flips a
ping-pong index, no copy at the flip
live
slot 5 evaluates it on every tick, with no AI, no worker and no
cron in the loop
F
EXECUTE
eight slots, all paper by default · the live arm (E1–E6, reviewed in E7) is armed per slot by --exec + --arm-live, testnet first

— open —
unbuilt
nothing here reaches a venue unless the operator arms a slot — and then six halts and four caps sit in front of it

exec-router routes paper / live PER SLOT on the Order.strategy_id byte that StampCtx wrote, and the two-switch interlock makes exec.toml and --arm-live name the same set or refuse the boot. LIVE_ARM_VENUES = [Hyperliquid]: an armed slot 3

gets a real HlExchange (signer, in-place request body, userFills pump, reconciliation, LAW E-8 sweeps) behind the E6 risk gate; every other live slot refuses. E7 = the TESTNET ramp R0–R3 (risk-policy "E7"); mainnet is a separate operator ruling.
G
OBSERVE, AND CLOSE THE LOOP
the same 64-byte records, read back — this is what makes the next authoring round honest
audit-pnl
replays the LOGGED intents through the SAME §4 fill law
per-strategy and per-ruleset-hash, per-day, descriptor-keyed
spawned by the pnl_report module on the 00:20Z timer
audit-replay
integrity, rates, opt-summary coverage, depth stale count
capture-catalog judges whether a window is fit to gate on
the 2-hour window law bounds every run, gate and soak
parity
the same ground truth for both carriers, so a table-lane row
and a coded member can be compared without a caveat
the 2026-09-11 measurement: replaying disjoint cuts as one
timeline already works, gaps preserved
the loop closes here — next round authors against measured fills
THE TWO CARRIERS, SIDE BY SIDE

yes, natively, by the frozen verb

Order.strategy_id = 5
Order.strategy_id = 4
The AI is a compiler, not a runtime. That sentence is still true — but only of the left-hand column.
The right-hand column is the one that would let a model trade live, and it is the one with no statistical gate —
which is exactly why it is paper-only, and why both sidecar lanes were asked to clear an offline bar before any
wire work began.
LAWS THE PIPELINE HAS PAID FOR
each of these was bought with a lane that had to be thrown away
run the no-model control FIRST
An illusion in one lane's harvest metric cost that whole lane, because nobody first ran the arm with the model
taken out.
a searched family needs a rolling origin
Not a half-split. A family you selected over is not a family you tested.
pre-register a baseline AND a null arm
In one lane the permuted null beat the real arm across 21 cells. Without a null arm, that reads as a result.
fee-first, per cell
Every cell reports against its own break-even bps before it is modelled at all.
the model never sets the sign
σ̂, size and gates only. Routing a forecast to direction is refused without a specific test.
never compare across different notionals
Two apparent results in one lane were a book-size artefact and a concatenation of separate simulation runs.
no window, gate or soak may exceed 2 hours
Operator law, 2026-09-03, absolute — the docs were amended the same day.
research never enters git
Absolute. It was violated once with two backtest records and the history was purged.
THE VERDICT LEDGER
deliberately not on this sheet
Which lanes ran, what each traded and why each closed all live
in docs/research/, which is git-excluded by an absolute operator
law. This sheet is tracked in git. So it carries the SHAPE of
the ledger and none of its content — that asymmetry is the point,
not an omission.
14 lanes reached a verdict in the seven weeks to 2026-09-19
live in paper
closed negative
closed in part
open / unarmed
A gate that never refuses is not a gate. Six outright refusals against four promotions is the ratio the
machinery in stages C and D exists to produce. If that ratio ever inverts without the fill law or the gate
thresholds changing, something upstream has stopped working.
WHAT A CLOSED LANE LEAVES BEHIND
a negative verdict is not a deletion
the pre-registered baseline
the number it had to beat, written down before the lane ran
the null arm
and what it scored, so the real arm can be judged against noise
every cell with its own n and SE
no ratio is reported without the uncertainty attached to it
the fee ladder
the break-even bps each cell was measured against, per venue
one paragraph
naming the single reason it failed, in plain language
WHY THAT PAPERWORK PAYS FOR ITSELF
Two of the four members now live in paper exist ONLY because an
earlier lane closed and left a finding behind: one inherited a
surviving component from a lane that was otherwise ruled negative,
and one was built the way it was precisely because a model blend
lost to a far simpler estimator at identical significance.
A lane that is deleted rather than written up takes both of those
with it.
READING THIS SHEET WITH THE LEDGER IN HAND
Anyone with repo access and the research directory can put the two
together in a minute. Anyone without it still gets everything this
sheet is actually for: where capture comes from, what the strategist
is allowed to read, what the two products are, what the gate checks,
how promotion crosses the process boundary, and what observes the
result. None of that needs a single strategy name to be correct.
That is the test this sheet was redacted against: remove every
identity, and see whether the machinery still explains itself.
STILL OPEN
the three questions a reader should ask next
the Stage-3 entry gate
A key, one keyed serve cycle, and one monitor rollback observed live. Nothing past it has ever run.
E7 on testnet
E6 and the E7 review are in code; R0 (the plumbing bar) waits on the operator's testnet .env + exec.toml and one
armed restart. Mainnet is a later ruling.
one lane's portability
Whether a member that works on one venue's short-dated binaries is worth reproducing on another's. Asked 09-15,
still unanswered.
WHAT THIS SHEET IS FOR

text.tspan: The pipeline's job is not to produce strategies. It is to make a refusal cheap and a promotion expensive.
Six of the fourteen lanes that reached a verdict were closed outright negative and a seventh in part, and the machinery that closed them — the frozen subprocess contract,

svg.text: the pessimistic fill law, the hash-bound gate, the null arm and the two-hour window — is worth more than any single one of the four members that survived. A reader who takes only one thing from this sheet should take the gate binding site in stage D: the point where refusing stopped being a matter of discipline and became a matter of exit codes.
still true from v1
The AI is a compiler, not a runtime: nothing the strategist produces executes as code in the
ruleset lane. The frozen verb surface, the descriptor-keyed data law, the one-writer serialization
and the stdout purity law all hold unchanged.
newly true in v2
The strategist also authors Rust members now, which the ruleset grammar cannot express. That is a
larger blast radius bought with a slower ruling, and it is how four of the eight slots changed
tenant in eleven days.
still not true
serve has never run — no Anthropic key is provisioned, so the keyed strategist daemon remains
parked and the standing mode is Claude-in-session. Auto-promotion and the monitor rollback proof
both still wait behind the Stage-3 entry gate.
the honest caveat
Everything above is paper. No order from any slot has reached a venue yet, and the four live members
have been measured only against a fill law deliberately built to under-promise. One live member is
the standing reminder that the fill model, not the signal, usually decides the number.

Sources for every claim on this sheet are the crates at HEAD 1225651 on 2026-09-19, re-checked against the E7 review tree the same day. Strategy and research-lane identities are omitted by design: this file is tracked in git, and that material is covered by the never-in-git law. The unredacted ledger lives in docs/research/, outside git, and is the companion to this sheet.
